From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Subject: EOQ: last-lap conversion stipend ask for SageHealth pilot

Ben / Marissa —

Quick context: SageHealth (Alex Kim) has a 6-week pilot that finishes this Friday. They've been heavy in evals (embedding indexing and multi-turn routing) and product likes the results, but procurement is pushing the timing to next quarter unless we offer a small conversion incentive. Net-new ARR is ~70k ARR if they convert; principal contact is Alex (Head of ML).

Request: Can we offer a one-time credit/stipend of $15,000 applied to first invoice to secure signature this quarter?

Why this matters now: if we don't convert this week they defer to a centralized procurement window in July — much slower and likely to request additional POCs. If we move fast we convert and can show Q2 momentum.

I attached the mutual action plan and the pilot usage summary. Proposed terms: $15k credit on first invoice, 12-month seat commitment, standard SOW + SOC2 addendum. If finance wants a different structure (e.g., invoice credit vs. usage rebate) I'm open.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben: quick approval or cap guidance (is $15k within delegated authority?)
- Marissa: sign-off on commercial terms to present to Alex
- If approved I'll send client note and loop procurement.

Thanks — I can jump on a 15-min call now if helpful.

—Connor
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attachments: MAP_SageHealth_v1.xlsx (xlsx), pilot-usage-summary.pdf (pdf)

Thanks for the context. $15k is within regional AE discretionary range but I need a quick note for finance documenting impact and expected ARR cadence (i.e., how much billed in Q3). Also flagging procurement implications — prefer credit on first invoice rather than a separate rebate program.

Please add the following to the client note you send:
- Deal ID: DEAL-18472
- Credit applied as invoice deduction on first invoice
- Committed term: 12 months, auto-renew quarterly (standard)
- Expected start: July 1st (billing to follow)

Marissa: if you sign off, I'll route the internal credit form to CC finance and legal for a 24-hour turn.

Ben
